fields.Name: Predictive Studio Gates — Pending
fields.Description: Gates that do not block a merge. G0.2 (W2 -> C1.1) and G0.3 (W3 -> C1.1) are owned by PR 4 (gated publish) and stay Pending until PR 4 activates them. G0.6 (W1 -> S9.3) is an LLM judge whose verdict can differ between runs on the same text; it needs AI_VENDOR_API_KEY__GeminiLLM set, runs unless RUN_AGENT_TESTS=0 (the live-model tier is on by default), and needs RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 because it trains and promotes a model. Needs MJAPI and the truth sidecar running and `pnpm run truth:provision` done. Run with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Pending"
